instruction: Do NOT overwrite the original. This pack provides versioned update content only.
project_scope: Empirical and mechanistic comparison of Non-LLM versus LLM-based forecasting architectures for influenza-like-illness (ILI) forecasting, under a pre-registered frozen selection rule on the national ILI dataset, with strict test/holdout isolation.
problem_statement: It is unclear whether integrating frozen large language models into time-series forecasters yields accuracy that is (a) superior to lightweight linear models and (b) attributable to the text/LLM mechanism rather than to the underlying seasonality of ILI data.
research_question: Across four Non-LLM and four LLM-based forecasting architectures, which performs best under the frozen selection rule, and does the LLM family as a whole reliably outperform the Non-LLM family?
objectives: Run a pre-registered, seed-replicated (10 seeds x 4 horizons) benchmark of 8 architectures.
Identify best Non-LLM, best LLM, and overall Wave-1 validation champion under the frozen rule.
Ablate the LLM mechanism (LoRA, multimodal fusion, prompt components) to localize any text contribution.
Preserve strict test/holdout isolation and a quota-safe compact-checkpoint pipeline.

methodology.dataset: national ILI, seven variables, z-space (train-only normalization)
methodology.selection_rule: rank by average_MSE_4L (mean of per-horizon mean MSE, lower better); key secondary average_MAE_4L; forbidden tie-breakers: peak-hit ratio, PTE/PIE, baseline-relative ratio, (r24+r60)/2
methodology.execution: serial fail-stop controller, 580 rows accepted, 0 ledger FAIL events, test/holdout 0/0

models_compared.note_patchtst: PatchTST-inspired reimplementation (no self-supervised pretraining, no RevIN, reduced capacity)

milestones_completed: Frozen protocol + selection rule recovered and verified (HPC_GUIDE SHA-256 verified).
580/580 durable packages reconciled; analysis dataset built (1 row/run).
Primary ranking, family comparison, horizon/seed stability, baselines, ablations, controls, efficiency computed.

llm_vs_nonllm.conclusion: Non-LLM family significantly more accurate; LLM win is one model (gpt2_miflu), not the paradigm.

ablation_control.note: negative controls exploratory (n=6 cells, L24/L60 x seeds 42-44)

test_holdout_stage: Test and holdout sealed (0/0); final publication champion not frozen; final manuscript pending.

risks.mitigation: report seed SD + 95% CI; ordering robust (non-overlapping CIs)
computed from reconstructed target week; secondary metric, never a tie-breaker

risks.risk: LLM cost (409x params, 28x time vs nlinear)

contributions: Empirical architecture comparison — pre-registered, seed-replicated (10 seeds x 4 horizons), test-isolated benchmark of 8 Non-LLM/LLM architectures under a frozen selection rule.
Mechanism / ablation evidence — localization of the LLM text contribution to the dataset-information component, with LoRA and multimodal fusion shown to be statistically inert.
Reproducible quota-safe framework — fail-closed, compact-checkpoint pipeline (580/580 accepted, 0 fail events, test/holdout 0/0) with bit-exact checkpoint compaction.
